title: Version Selector Example
text:
Enable the filter in _quarto.yml:
filters:
  - version-selector
To place the selector somewhere specific, add an element with id version-selector:
::: {#version-selector}
:::

title: quarto-version-selector
text:
A for Quarto websites. The selector appears in the navbar once the site is deployed with quarto-version-selector deploy, which writes a versions.json file to the root of the docs branch.
See the README for usage.
